title: Microsoft Viva: Interactive insights in Agent 365 Business Analytics
summary: The briefing passes: its preview behaviour, access controls and roadmap targets are supported, including the updated PowerShell guidance. Minor corrections should finish the two administration paths, distinguish the app's published licensing prerequisite from feature-specific gaps, and keep the general availability date conditional.
